value_updates.referral_explanation: Explain that a mint number is the permanent referral code, successful referrals award $5 plus a Small Block prize ticket, and a no-code mint sends the commission and Small Block ticket to a random existing NFT holder.
value_updates.prize_explanation: Explain the continuing Small Block $500 prizes funded through the block prize pool and omit the eliminated Big Block prize.
value_updates.ticket_explanation: Explain that referrals earn entries for the recurring Small Block $500 prizes, that more tickets increase the chance of winning, and that tickets expire after the applicable Small Block draw.

how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and Small Block ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket, and more referrals provide more chances to win the recurring $500 prizes.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards recurring $500 prizes funded through the block prize pool, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.
